TASHKENTSPIRE2-TASHKENT_CHARACTER.title: Tashkent
TASHKENTSPIRE2-TASHKENT_CHARACTER.descri:
Tashkent is a flotilla leader destroyer from the Northern Parliament.
Having arrived at the Spire, she fights as hard as she did during the Battle of Sevastopol.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-TASHKENT_CHARACTER.banter: Dear comrade... it's still not over yet...?
TASHKENTSPIRE2-TASHKENT_CHARACTER.aromaP: [sine][blue]I have to return to my dear comrade's side...[/blue][/sine]
TASHKENTSPIRE2-TASHKENT_CHARACTER.goldMo: [sine]These Gold Coins will definitely be useful to my dear comrade...[/sine]
TASHKENTSPIRE2-TASHKENT_CHARACTER.cardsM: Tashkent's cards can now appear in rewards and shops.
